purpose: Design for extracting formal references, checking them by real directory scans, and notifying change-impact candidates by comparing recorded content hashes with current hashes.
summary: Formal references are reference-link definitions whose title ends with a DLID, with an optional recorded 12-char content hash before it
Real directory scan classifies targets as match, path mismatch, or absent, plus fragment mismatch checks against anchors
Path-mismatch fixes are notified only when the same ID is uniquely confirmed by scanning; no current path is guessed
Links without a DLID get a suggested title value (content hash plus DLID) computed from the live target
Reverse references are built from scanned sources and limited to documents and sections in the confirmed ToC
Impact candidates are references whose recorded hash differs from the current hash or has no record
Indirect referrers are not listed; impact propagates one step per detection
Notification returns changed IDs, recorded hashes, referrer locations and scope; doc-link keeps no notification state and edits nothing
Consistency checks are split into check-dlid, check-links, check-toc and check-impact and never modify managed state
tasks: Designing or reviewing reference extraction from link titles
Handling path mismatch, missing target and fragment mismatch diagnostics
Computing title values for links lacking a DLID
Writing tests for reference and impact behavior
Deciding how a project management AI should rewrite recorded hashes
title: DES-007 参照検査と[変更影響候補の通知]
